title: gentle-factory Design Comment Frontmatter
description: Schema for machine-readable design comment frontmatter block consumed by gentle-factory.

schema_version.description: Version of the design comment format.

issue.description: Issue number this design applies to.

ready_signal.description: Label or directive indicating human readiness.

done_when.description: Machine-checkable shell command, test path, or assertion proving completion.

expected_files.description: List of expected file paths or glob patterns permitted for mutation.

gate_level.description: Depth of gate checks to execute.

budget_cap_usd.description: Optional custom budget cap override for this issue in USD.

turn_cap.description: Optional custom turn cap override for this issue.

timeout_seconds.description: Optional outer timeout override in seconds.
